# Hello!

I am a **Denmark-based researcher** and **cognitive-behavioral therapist** from São Paulo, Brazil.  I am currently pursuing my PhD in **Psychology and Behavioral Sciences** at **Aarhus University**, where I study the links between **emotion regulation, affect, and cannabis use** in daily life.
